documentation_best_practices: Use clear folder structure matching content hierarchy
Split large documents into logical sections
Include visual diagrams for complex concepts
Maintain consistency in formatting and style
docusaurus_patterns: Always include frontmatter with sidebar_position and title
Use MDX features for enhanced interactivity
Add proper links between related pages
gitignore_patterns: Group related patterns with clear section headers
Use negation patterns (!) to explicitly include important files
Keep environment templates but ignore actual .env files
Separate project-specific patterns from general patterns
Consider both Python and Node.js ecosystems for mixed projects
project_management: Always use uv for Python package management in this project
Multi-tenant architecture must be considered in all components
All I/O operations must be async-first
Use Pydantic for all configuration management
Everything is a tool that agents can use
Always update history.json for significant changes
Document in gutenberg/ with proper Docusaurus structure
Use centralized logging with Loguru, never print statements
Follow existing patterns before creating new implementations
autogen_patterns: Agents must have standard folder structure with agent.py, config.yaml, README.md
Tools must inherit from BaseTool and register with ToolRegistry
Use AutoGen's AssistantAgent and UserProxyAgent patterns
Implement proper conversation management for multi-turn interactions
Create orchestrators for complex agent interactions
integration_insights: Telegram bots use telegram_tool.py with full async support
Browser automation uses browser_use library with session management
Image generation integrated via DALL-E with configurable parameters
Memory management uses conversation_memory for context retention
All integrations must support multi-tenant isolation
